root_idea.summary: The root centers on a needed or desired object: a want, important need, or objective one seeks to accomplish.
root_idea.development: The noun denotes a need or object of desire; in the Quranic construction قَضَى ... وَطَرًا, the need or desired objective has been fulfilled, leaving no further need of it. The supplied root evidence states that no verb is built from this root.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested noun is presented under its normalized citation form وَطَر.

senses.definition: A need, desire, or sought objective; a matter one wishes or purposes to accomplish.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression قَضَى ... وَطَرًا, it refers to the need or desired objective that has been fulfilled, so that no further need of the matter remains.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The unit's want, need, and accomplished-object meanings, including the cited Quranic construction, are represented; its plural and no-verb notes are grammatical.

cautions: The two Quran occurrences are the same noun in the construction قَضَى ... وَطَرًا; the contextual English gloss does not establish a separate meaning of “formalities.”
